title: When Consumption Regulations Backfire: The Role of Political Ideology
design_notes: Study 1 is a natural experiment on California's hands-free phone law (effective January 1, 2017) using hourly unique website visits from a telecom operator for 58 counties, December-January 2015/16 vs. 2016/17. Model is a triple-difference (Conservatism x After x Treatment) with Poisson and negative binomial estimators and county-level controls (cars, trucks, commute time); county dummies in Panel B. Studies 2-4 are lab experiments.
eligible_reason: Single law date in one state; nonlinear count models (Poisson, negative binomial); triple-difference with continuous conservatism interaction; no staggered adoption.
screener_notes: Hourly web-traffic data from a proprietary telecom analytics tool; no replication package. Ineligible on design.
screened_from: article text only (no package_dir or regressions file in batch_t2_004)
